reasons.attach-pr: its entire purpose is Claude Code Desktop's PR-card detector, which no other harness has, and it reaches its resolver through a Claude-only skill-directory placeholder
reasons.resolve-ticket: needs plugin-path placeholders, a pinned Claude model, and Claude-only subagent, worktree, and question tools
reasons.review-pr: its whole mechanism is a script reached through a Claude-only skill-directory placeholder, plus a pinned Claude model
reasons.watch-review: pinned Claude model, and it drives review-pr through Claude Code's own skill-invocation tool

visual.claude: the Browser pane (start or attach a preview, then take a screenshot), an attached Chrome, or the iOS Simulator control tool; some arrive only after a tool search, so an empty tool list is not proof of absence
visual.codex: the bundled browser plugin, else computer-use, else Playwright driven from the shell
visual.cursor: Browser Preview against a running dev server, else a Playwright server if one is registered
visual.hermes: no built-in renderer; Playwright driven from the shell is the only rung, and only when the project already depends on it
visual.opencode: no built-in renderer; a registered Playwright server or the Playwright CLI

memoryTarget.claude: the per-user `CLAUDE.md` in the Claude config directory
memoryTarget.codex: the per-user `AGENTS.md` in the Codex home directory
memoryTarget.cursor: a generated rules file in the per-user Cursor rules directory
memoryTarget.hermes: `SOUL.md` in the Hermes home, and only once `leo:setup enable hermes-memory` turns it on — that file is the agent's own identity prompt, so it is never written to unasked and never created
memoryTarget.opencode: the per-user `AGENTS.md` in the OpenCode config directory
